subject: Contract paperwork sync — renewal + capacity uplift
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@quantaworks.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@quantaworks.com>
Date: 2028-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Contract paperwork sync — renewal + capacity uplift

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. QuantaWorks is ready to move forward on a renewal, but we need to align a couple of paperwork items before legal signs:

1) Term: customer wants to extend from 12 months to a 24-month term (preferred start 2029-01-01).
2) Capacity uplift: target +350% token throughput across our primary environment (US-East).
3) Single consolidated deliverable: we'd like a consolidated package that updates the MSA, SOW and the pricing exhibit together (one tracked-markup file).
4) Data/audit questions: please confirm current log retention and data access/audit rights for dedicated customers — procurement needs wording for audit clauses.

If you can, please share a clean draft with markup suggestions and a short list of contract clauses that will need explicit negotiation (e.g., SLA credits, data residency, export controls). We can run an internal review once we have that and aim to sign by end of October if timing works.

Attached is a short list of Quanta's requirements and a sample PO timeline.

(Attachment: QuantaRenewal_Requests.pdf)

Best,
Evan Brooks
Head of Procurement, QuantaWorks
E: evan.brooks@quantaworks.com | M: +1 415-555-0192

Evan — thanks for the clear list. Happy to coordinate. High-level plan on our side:

- Karthik + Laura (contracts) will produce a consolidated tracked-change package for the MSA + SOW + Pricing Exhibit by EOD 10/20.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with your procurement and legal to call out the key updates (proposed: Wed 10/24 or Thu 10/25). Please confirm which works.
- For audit/logging language, Laura: can you prepare a short summary of current retention and our recommended wording for audit access (two short bullets we can add)?

To help us prioritize, what is Quanta's preferred sign-by date? You mentioned end of Oct in your note — confirmation will help queue internal approvals.

Subject: Re: Contract paperwork sync — renewal + capacity uplift

Neha — noted. Internal legal/contract action items from my side:

- We'll prepare a single tracked document that combines the current MSA + SOW + Pricing exhibit; call it "proposed_clean_and_markup.docx".
- Items to flag for negotiation: SLA credit formula for multi-region failover; data residency clauses if Quanta requires EU-only storage; audit window and scope (calendar days notice, which systems included).
- Pricing: need clarification on how Quanta defines "throughput" for the +350% uplift (peak sustained vs burst). That affects Exhibit pricing bands.

Marissa — can you run an ops assessment on whether the requested uplift triggers any special provisioning or capacity reservation logic (dedicated pools vs burst)? If so, we should include language and lead times in the SOW.

I'll have a tracked package to Neha and Laura by COB 10/20; please treat this as priority — Quanta's PO timeline looks tight.

(Attachment: proposed_clean_and_markup.docx)

Karthik Iyer
VP, Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@quantaworks.com>

Date: 2028-10-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract paperwork sync — renewal + capacity uplift

Neha — thanks, received the drive link and the first-pass exhibit. Quick responses and next steps from our side: 

- We attached a single annotated markup with in-line comments (QW_Markup_2028-10-21.docx). The key negotiation points from our counsel: (a) limit audit scope to account-related logs and only with 10 business days' notice, (b) carve out encryption key management language to confirm Quanta retains keys for customer-owned deployments, and (c) a one-time onboarding fee for dedicated pool provisioning.
- Regarding throughput measurement: Quanta measures sustained 95th percentile token throughput over 30-day windows. We'll add that note to the markup so pricing matches your bands.
- Signoff timeline: procurement aims to issue a PO by 2028-11-01; legal would like final contract language by 2028-10-27 to avoid slipping the PO. Can Redwood commit to that draft cadence?
